entities.name: Transport of NAS messages procedure
entities.description: Procedure to carry SMS messages in an encapsulated form between the MME and the UE. Can be initiated by UE or network.

entities.name: NAS message container IE
entities.description: Information element used to encapsulate SMS messages for transport.

entities.name: Control Plane Service Request message
entities.description: Message used to transport first SMS message when UE is in EMM-IDLE mode with control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: UE attached for EPS and non-EPS services or EPS and SMS only
entities.description: Condition requiring UE to be attached for EPS services and non-EPS services or for EPS services and SMS only.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT EPS optimization
entities.description: Condition when UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: No PDN connections established
entities.description: Property where UE does not have any PDN connections established.

relations.description: Transport of NAS messages procedure requires UE to be attached for EPS and non-EPS services or EPS and SMS only.
Transport of NAS messages procedure requires UE to be in EMM-CONNECTED mode.
Control Plane Service Request message contains NAS message container IE for SMS transport.
When UE is using control plane CIoT EPS optimization, first SMS message is transported via Control Plane Service Request message.
When UE is using control plane CIoT EPS optimization, network can initiate downlink transport even if UE has no PDN connections.
